facts.text: Spring Creek Ranch is located on a wildlife sanctuary above the town of Jackson.

facts.text: Spring Creek Ranch sits atop East Gros Ventre Butte.

facts.text: Spring Creek Ranch is located almost 1,000 feet above the town of Jackson.

facts.text: The former open range around the ranch is protected in perpetuity as nearly 1,000 acres of open space.
facts.excerpt: What was once open range is now protected in perpetuity as nearly 1,000 acres of open space, and is home to more than 100 species of birds and wildlife.

facts.text: The protected open space is home to more than 100 species of birds and wildlife.

facts.text: The ranch's location gives it views of the Teton Mountain Range, including the Grand Teton.
facts.excerpt: Because of the unique location, it has the most spectacular views of the Teton Mountain Range, including the world famous Grand Teton.

facts.text: Guests can choose from Inn Rooms, Studios, Suites, Townhomes or Mountain Villas.
facts.excerpt: Our luxury ranch provides guests with a choice of Inn Rooms, Studios, Suites, Townhomes or Mountain Villas.

facts.text: All Mountain Villas include four bedrooms, four baths, a full kitchen, dining room, living room and fireplaces throughout.
facts.excerpt: All include 4 bedrooms, 4 baths, full kitchen, dining room, living room, and fireplaces throughout.

facts.text: The Mountain Villas are uniquely furnished by each owner in a cozy, western style.
facts.excerpt: Uniquely furnished by each owner, they display a cozy, western atmosphere.

facts.text: Room amenities include a wood-burning fireplace.
facts.excerpt: Wood-burning fireplace

facts.text: The units do not have air conditioning.
facts.excerpt: While we do not have A/C in our units similar to most hotels and resorts in Jackson, guests can enjoy the fresh cool mountain breeze

facts.text: The ranch has a seasonal outdoor heated pool.
facts.excerpt: our seasonal outdoor heated pool,

facts.text: The ranch has salt water hot tubs and an Equestrian Center.
facts.excerpt: salt water hot tubs and our Equestrian Center.

facts.text: Guests can have a custom massage in an authentic teepee.
facts.excerpt: Relax and experience your custom massage in our authentic Teepee

facts.text: Guests can roast marshmallows over an open fire pit and watch the sunset over the Tetons.
facts.excerpt: Roast marshmallows over our open fire-pit and take in the breath-taking sunset over the Tetons.

facts.text: The Wilderness Adventure Spa environment is cell phone free.
facts.excerpt: The Spa is a peaceful place of refuge. Our environment is cell phone free so that you may leave feeling stress free!

facts.text: The Wilderness Adventure Spa has a fitness room, an indoor hot tub and an outdoor saltwater hot tub.
facts.excerpt: the Wilderness Adventure Spa also has a complete Fitness Room, an Indoor Hot Tub, and an Outdoor Saltwater Hot Tub.

facts.text: The spa offers high-altitude facials designed to protect skin from the dry, high-altitude air.
facts.excerpt: Rejuvenate your skin and protect if from the dry, high-altitude air with the right facial for your skincare needs.

facts.text: The spa's Teton Forest Massage starts with a mineral scrub and follows with a White Pine and Basil full body massage.
facts.excerpt: Start with a mineral scrub to heal dry climate skin with mud bubbling on your spine. After rinsing, we follow with a White Pine and Basil full body massage.

facts.text: The open space of East Gros Ventre Butte is available to guests for horseback riding, hiking and cross country skiing.
facts.excerpt: In addition, the open space of East Gros Ventre Butte is yours for horseback riding, hiking, and cross country skiing.

facts.text: The ranch's resident naturalist leads snowshoe excursions to find wild animal tracks.
facts.excerpt: Spring Creek Ranch’s resident naturalist invites you on a 1- 2 mile snowshoe excursion to find wild animal tracks!

- Wildlife Tours

facts.text: During the ski season the shuttle also serves Jackson Hole Mountain Resort.
